tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Jack wants to talk about family weekend. what meal to make. who will come. when to arrive.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Jack.

promptBlocks.subject: Family visit
paragraphs: I am writing about family weekend. what meal to make? who will come?
when to arrive? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Jack and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: family weekend
ketImageBrief.panel1: Jack starts family weekend with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Jack solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
